mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_count FROM schedule WHERE schedule_type = 'COMMON' AND schedule_start >= CURDATE() AND schedule_end >= CURDATE();
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule WHERE (schedule_type = 'PERSONAL' OR schedule_type = 'APPROVAL') AND schedule_start <= CURDATE() AND schedule_end >= CURDATE() AND employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM electronic_approval AS ea LEFT JOIN ea_approval_request AS ear ON ea.approval_id = ear.approval_id LEFT JOIN ea_business_trip AS ebt ON ea.approval_id = ebt.approval_id WHERE ea.writer_employee_id = #{employeeId} AND ( ea.approval_status = 'PENDING' OR ( ea.approval_status = 'APPROVE' AND ea.ea_type = 'APPROVAL_REQUEST' AND ear.approval_request_execution_date >= CURDATE() ) OR ( ea.approval_status = 'APPROVE' AND ea.ea_type = 'BUSINESS_TRIP' AND ebt.business_trip_end >= CURDATE() ) )
SELECT schedule_title AS noticeTitle, schedule_content AS noticeContent, created_at AS createdAt, 'SCHEDULE' AS noticeType FROM schedule WHERE schedule_type = 'COMMON'
SELECT title AS noticeTitle, content AS noticeContent, created_date AS createdAt, 'BOARD' AS noticeType FROM gr_board WHERE category = 'notice'
SELECT * FROM schedule WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND schedule_type IN ('PERSONAL', 'APPROVAL') AND schedule_end >= CURDATE() ORDER BY schedule_start ASC, schedule_id ASC LIMIT 4
